senses.gloss: m. (a corrupt. of πυργίσκος = armarium, v. Fränkel, Zeitschr. f. Assyriol., April 1894, p. 8) a chest in the wall, closet.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 7:13">Tosef. Ohol. VII, 13</cite> <he>תיבה שעשאה פ׳</he> R. S. to Ohol. VI, 7 (ed. Zuck. <he>פרסטק׳</he>, <cite ref="Q01593"><he>פרסתק׳</he></cite>) a chest which one put up in the wall as a closet. Ib. 14 <he>פ׳ שהוא פתוח וכ׳</he> a closet standing open in a locked room. Ib. 15; Ohol. VI, 7 <he>רואין את הפ׳ כאילו הוא וכ׳</he> (ed. Dehr. <he>כאילו הם וכ׳</he>) we consider the closet as if it were a solid wall.—Pl. <cite ref="Q01593"><he>פַּרְרַּסְקִין</he></cite>. Ib.—V. <cite ref="Q01583"><he>פַּרְדִּיסְקִים</he></cite>.
